searchText: Do you guys think this makes sense: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/199 ? hey party people. question - with optimistic flag, should the `/eth/v1/node/syncing` report syncing: true if we're in optimistic sync mode? Specifically if the beacon chain has been fully sync'd optimistically but we're still waiting on the EL to finish syncing to verify the payload.
